resources.string: Keep your car details and service history together.
Choose the language for this app.
Your data is stored on this phone. No account is needed.
A schedule must match the exact vehicle variant. No manufacturer deadlines are shown without verified data.
Your confirmed service entries will appear here. Missing documents do not mean a service was missed.
Make, model or your own name
Model year may differ from the first registration year. Leave blank if unknown.
Your saved data could not be loaded. Try again.
The changes could not be saved. Your previous data is unchanged. Try again.
Use a car name of 80 characters or fewer.
Enter a valid model year, or leave it blank.
Use this as the current odometer reading
Historical entries do not automatically replace the current reading.
Changing or removing the selected reading clears the current selection unless you choose to keep it current.
This reading is more than 90 days old. Update it before relying on distance estimates.
Add a car to start recording its history.
The work items and its odometer reading will be removed. If that reading is current, you will need to select or add a current reading again.
If this is the current reading, no other reading will be selected automatically.
This value conflicts with readings on other dates. Correct it or explain the exception, for example a replaced odometer.
There is a different reading on this date. Check which value is correct.
You are choosing a reading older than the current one. Check that this is intentional.
I have checked these readings and want to keep this value
This note does not convert mileage between old and replaced odometers.
Enter a valid date in the shown format.
A completed service or actual reading cannot be dated in the future.
Enter whole, non-negative kilometers. Leave optional mileage blank if unknown.
Add at least one completed work item.
Choose the work and operation, or describe the custom work.
The same work item has been added twice.
Use a non-negative NOK amount with at most two decimal places in the shown format.
The note or description is too long.
Check the current warnings, add an explanation and confirm them before saving.
This entry no longer exists. Return to history.
This entry changed while you were editing. Reopen it to avoid overwriting newer data.
Check the vehicle details and keep each field within 80 characters.
These changes have not been saved.
Enter only what you know. These details are not decoded or matched to a manufacturer schedule yet.
This is separate from the model year. Leave unknown dates blank.
You choose these intervals. They are your settings and are not manufacturer recommendations.
Enter at least one positive whole number. Months must be between 1 and 1200. If both are set, the earlier limit applies.
Calculated from the last recorded matching action and operation. Add that service entry if it is missing.
Enter a positive distance and/or 1–1200 whole months.
You already have an interval for this action and operation. Edit that interval.
No intervals to calculate yet. You can add your own interval while a verified manufacturer schedule is unavailable.
This removes the interval and its calculated result. Your service history stays saved.
A verified manufacturer schedule is not available for this car yet. Your own intervals are shown separately.
No verified schedule matches the saved car configuration. Your own intervals are shown separately.
More car details are needed before a manufacturer schedule can be assigned.
One matching manufacturer schedule cannot be confirmed yet.
The manufacturer source is not currently approved or valid. Its recommendations are unavailable.
The manufacturer schedule cannot be confirmed. Your own intervals remain available.
The service overview could not be calculated. Check the saved data and try again.
No confirmation of this action and operation is recorded. This does not mean the service was missed.
Select or enter a current odometer reading. Historical readings do not replace your selection.
The last matching service entry has no recorded mileage.
The first registration date is missing or needs correction.
This schedule is determined by the car. A service indicator reading is needed; a fixed interval is not substituted.
The selected odometer reading is older than 90 days. Update it before relying on the remaining distance.
The distance limit may already have been reached. Update the odometer reading.
The odometer readings need review. A counter replacement is not converted into total distance automatically.
A newer reading with higher mileage is in the history. Review which reading should be current.
The source has expired. This is not a currently verified recommendation.
Entries dated in the future were excluded from the calculation.
This interval and mileage cannot be calculated reliably. Check the saved values.
More information is needed to show a confirmed limit.
Difference from the recorded reading: %1$s km
First registration and 0 km, as defined by this schedule
Service indicator reading from the car
Mileage at the starting point: %1$s km
The distance or time limit that occurs first applies.
Estimated month at the recorded driving rate: %1$s. This is an estimate, separate from the schedule.
Upper limit for a variable schedule; check the car indicator
Service indicator reading from the car
